input: Make a homemade holiday wreath from foraged branches

gold.taskTitle: Make a Homemade Holiday Wreath from Foraged Branches
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to create a holiday wreath by hand using branches and materials gathered from nature.

questions.title: Which holiday is this wreath being made for?
questions.description: Knowing the holiday (Christmas, Hanukkah, Winter Solstice, etc.) will shape the color palette, symbols, and overall aesthetic of the wreath.

questions.title: What is your target deadline or display date?
questions.description: Understanding when the wreath needs to be finished helps prioritize foraging, drying, and assembly timelines.

questions.title: Where do you plan to hang or display it?
questions.description: An outdoor front door wreath has different durability needs than an indoor mantel or wall piece, affecting material choices.

questions.title: What size wreath are you aiming to make?
questions.description: The diameter of the wreath determines how many foraged materials are needed and what base frame size to source.

questions.title: What types of branches or greenery grow near you?
questions.description: Knowing locally available materials — such as pine, eucalyptus, holly, or cedar — determines what can realistically be foraged.

questions.title: Do you want to add non-foraged decorative elements?
questions.description: Items like ribbon, pinecones, berries, candles, or ornaments may supplement the foraged branches and define the final style.

questions.title: Do you have any wreath-making tools or supplies already?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has a wire frame, floral wire, pruning shears, or hot glue gun helps identify what still needs to be acquired.
